scope: Static independent review of required local export UI test oracle and integration coverage; no source/tree/ref changes; no M05 or provider acceptance expansion.

checks.detail: PDF pages and share button appear only after LightingPlanPDF.make returns data and the current options match. Editable-copy save button appears only after a real LightingProjectDocument and ProjectBackupFile are successfully prepared. These checks are stronger than unconditional identifier existence and do not bypass document construction.

Unique fixture namespace plus full-library launch flag; initial Saved locally; actual added fourth light; Unsaved changes; PDF and copy preparations; unchanged dirty state; undo removes fourth light and restores Saved locally; reopening at three lights preserves redo; redo restores unsaved fourth light; relaunch shows original saved project with no fourth light or history. This exercises local no-save/no-history-change behavior. It does not compare all unrelated library records or every scene field.

Copy to PDF reopening asserts chooser reset and absence of prior document labels. Reopening editable copy after undo asserts a fresh three-light summary rather than prior four-light snapshot. It does not decode the UI-prepared bytes, so content-level stale snapshot substitution could evade this test while summary labels remain current.

Native PDF source tests parse generated data with PDFKit, assert actual page counts/media boxes/equipment/units/precision/room text and attach PDFs. Native backup test writes prepared.data, reads through production async ProjectDocumentIO, asserts whole-document equality and unchanged bytes. These are substantive serialization oracles, but they construct their own inputs and do not capture bytes from the UI snapshot path.

Format chooser Cancel and Done dismissal are tested with editor/history assertions. Neither shareLightingPlanPDF nor saveEditableProjectCopy is tapped. System share/file-export cancellation, post-cancel Save reenablement, and exporter callback status behavior are not exercised by these methods. Do not label their current coverage canceled system sharing; no new M05/provider completion condition is inferred.

Two keepAlways XCUIScreen screenshots capture current screens after readiness assertions. There is no image comparison, text extraction or assertion about preview content/readability. They support separate actual-image review when executed and recovered; screenshots alone do not prove PDF/JSON payload correctness, successful sharing, test terminal success or current runtime pass.

M03 requires successful existing functional workflows and honest evidence. M05 export/open/provider scope remains pending. Review finds no demonstrated blocking product defect or weakened required assertion in the scoped files. Existing readiness and state assertions should be retained.

nonblocking_coverage_opportunities: To strengthen existing local snapshot guarantees, add an integration oracle that inspects the actual prepared snapshot payload for the added-light UUID or distinct setting, then repeats after undo/reopen; current UI labels alone cannot establish serialized snapshot freshness.

If local system-cancel handling is subsequently modified, exercise open/cancel and restored button/history/status behavior in an Apple runtime. This is an identified coverage boundary, not a newly imposed provider/M05 gate.
limitations: Remote source review only. No host filesystem, scripts, Xcode, simulator, tests or screenshots were executed/viewed in this worker.
